title: Tac-Kek Heavy Trooper mask for Ops-Core-type helmets

infobox.armor coverage: Face, Head top, Eyes, Jaws, Throat
infobox.penalties: -2% turn speed, -5% Ergonomics, No sound reduction

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- This mask is based on the heavy gunner helmet from the brand "GALAC-TAC", replicating helmets worn by Mandalorians in the "Star Wars" movie series.
- Tac-Kek is a play on "TacTec", a line of tactical gear by the brand "5.11".
- "Kek" is the shortened form of "kekeke", a transliteration of an onomatopoetic Korean phrase used online to represent laughter. It's the equivalent to "hahaha".
